name: kch-instruction-governance

# KCH instruction governance

Apply credal uncertainty only after authority and applicability are established. Preserve `EXTERNAL_PLATFORM > HARNESS > AGENTS > RULES > SESSION_POLICY > MODEL_PROPOSAL` as deterministic precedence.

## Procedure

1. Recover the exact instruction, provenance, attested authority, jurisdiction, scope, operation, validity, dependencies, exceptions and versions.
2. Abstain when authority is unattested. Never turn model confidence, frequency or probability into authority.
3. Filter typed applicability first. An exception selects cases; it does not rewrite evidence or a credal profile.
4. Resolve cross-layer differences by hard precedence. A weaker layer cannot supersede a stronger layer.
5. Use robust credal dominance only among alternatives in the same layer. Without dominance, return `ASK_USER`, `ABSTAIN`, `NOT_ESTIMABLE` or a conflict set; never invent a tie-break.
6. Clarify only with questions backed by a verifiable calibration receipt. Rank robust minimax contraction of decisional imprecision per cost. Stop when no question has positive contraction or its likelihoods are not estimable.
7. Compile structured context only from a closed `APPLY` resolution. Mark it as data, not as a new system-authority channel.
8. Never trigger automatic execution from ambiguity, abstention or conflict. Consult the user directly under the active consultative policy.
9. Persist instruction, version, evidence and idempotent receipt in one transaction. Describe a hash chain as local tamper detection, not physical immutability.

## Integration

Prefer the CSI runtime's `instruction_governance_*` operators when available. If the host does not expose them, apply this protocol natively and disclose that the executable kernel was not invoked. Do not create a parallel service or use MCP unless a concrete external-capability gap is documented.

PHL may propose future questions or calibrations after genuine feedback; never auto-promote them or claim real PHL training.

## Closure

Report the effective instruction, authority basis, decision state, preserved conflicts, evidence, claim ceiling and next critical action. Keep `capability`, `permission`, `authority`, `execution` and `training` separate.
